汉字栏作[疑:芳/發]，依 Brozar 语链取"发"义

entries.en: to sprout (tree); to resolve/awaken resolve (Buddhist bhesallī sense)
spirit, sprite (thing turned into a spirit)

entries.zh: 怪物；被妖魔迷惑（附身）者
entries.notes: 西语尾词拼写缺损（enformoniado/enbornoniado？），语义依赖推断

entries.en: human spirit, person turned spirit; witch (of a person)

entries.notes: melisica 词形未定（Melusina 传说妖灵？），降置信

entries.notes: Vieja 拼[疑:V/B]ieja；汉字"古怪"两栏互证清晰
汉字[疑:洗/揉]与西语 brunir 略有出入，降置信
